assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production visual-language reference, not a final game asset. Primary request: create a single 16:9 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art master frame for The First Nine. Scene/backdrop: side-view Thornwake Forest at night, foreground thorny roots and a recoverable coil of rope and metal wheel part, midground Lolth standing near a weathered elven caravan and amber campfire, one readable Briar Hound enemy at a distance, background ruined forest and two parallax depth layers. Subject: Lolth is an elegant, strong, pale blue-gray elven woman with long white hair, a restrained dark violet-and-black travelling outfit with fine gold accents; preserve this visual language without copying any reference image. Style/medium: cohesive handcrafted pixel art with readable clusters, no painterly rendering. Composition/framing: 1280x720 side-view gameplay scene, Lolth and wagon on shared ground, generous clear upper-corner HUD safe areas, strong foreground/midground/background separation. Lighting/mood: melancholic cold blue-violet moonlit night, almost-black violet shadows, localized warm amber-gold firelight. Materials/textures: cracked wood, worn metal, rope, wet stone, roots. Constraints: clear silhouettes for player, wagon, enemy and pickup; no text, no UI icons, no logo, no watermark, no sprite sheet, no collage, no extra named characters.
checks: Lolth, wagon, Briar Hound, salvage pickup, HUD-safe space and parallax all visible
cold violet night and warm amber fire contrast

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production visual-language reference board, not a final game asset. Primary request: create a clean 2D dark-fantasy pixel-art palette and material board for The First Nine. Include unlabeled swatches and small material studies only: cold blue-violet night ramps, near-black violet shadow ramps, warm amber-gold fire ramps, muted earth ramps; cracked dark wood, worn iron and brass, frayed rope, wet stone, thorny root, soft bioluminescent fungus and translucent desert glass. Include one small abstract side-view value study with foreground, midground and background depth; no characters and no functional UI. Style/medium: crisp pixel art clusters, coherent with a melancholic elven caravan journey. Composition/framing: organized 16:9 board, generous spacing, each material visually distinct without text. Lighting/mood: cold moonlight against a warm fire accent. Constraints: no letters, numbers, logos, watermark, photorealism, sprite sheet, game-ready texture atlas or runtime asset.
checks: all seven material studies visibly distinct
value ramps include violet night, violet shadow, amber fire and muted earth
